note: RISK-ONLY CHECK NOT COMPLETED — no verifiable data obtained. Tooling failure: the DuckDuckGo/searx backend returned 'Connection refused' on every web_search call; html.duckduckgo.com timed out; Google returned HTTP 429; Bing ignored the quoted entity name and returned only unrelated global 'Horizon' brands (Horizon Credit Union, Horizon Hobby, VMware Horizon, Meta Horizon) across three differently-phrased queries, i.e. zero India-specific hits. The OFAC Sanctions List Search page (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) was reachable but is a JavaScript form that returns no results via plain GET, so no SDN/Non-SDN name match could be executed. Consequently: sanctions exposure (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List) = NOT VERIFIED, not 'clear'; Indian court cases (party role/status) = NOT VERIFIED; regulator actions and negative news with dates = NOT VERIFIED; credit rating with date/status = NOT VERIFIED (no rating found, and none is asserted); evidence of supplies to Russia or CIS = NOT VERIFIED. All fields set to null deliberately — no numbers, CINs, PANs, case numbers or shipment records were invented. Per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground and NOT a negative finding: the company must not be treated as sanctioned or as having court/regulatory issues on the basis of this null result. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend and a POST-capable OFAC/OpenSanctions lookup, plus a CIN-based query (CIN was not supplied in the input, which is the main blocker for registry, court and rating lookups).
